Dear Sir/Madam, 
This is with reference to our intimation dated 14th October 2026 regarding notice of Board Meeting, 
inter-alia, to consider and approve unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and 
half-year ended 30th September 2026.  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, this is to inform that post-results Conference Call of the Company has been scheduled on 
Tuesday, 3rd November 2026 at 12:00 Noon (IST) as per the details contained in Annexure- 1 
attached herewith. 
This is for your kind information and records please. 
Yours faithfully, 
(Rajan Kapur) 
GGM & President - Company Secretary
